messages.text: We're seeing duplicate charges on three accounts this month. Can you look into it urgently?
On it now. Ill confirm the scope within the hour and refund anything duplicated today.
Confirmed: 3 accounts, 4 duplicate charges, total 18,400. Refunds initiated, they take 5-7 days to land.
Thank you for the quick turnaround.
Will you send something in writing about how this happened?
Yes - well send a short RCA once weve finished the investigation.

loops.statement: confirm the scope of the duplicate charges and refund them
send the customer a written RCA for the duplicate charges
loops.notes: Conditional on a certain event — the investigation is already running — so it is a loop, unlike a conditional on an uncertain one.
